title: 063. Kth Largest Element In An Array
javaSig: public int findKthLargest(int[] nums, int k)
prompt: Given integer array `nums` and `k`, return the `k`-th largest element without sorting the entire array.
invariant: Min-heap of top K elements -> heap[0] is K-th largest
steps: For `x` in `nums`: `heappush(heap, x)` and if `len(heap) > k`, `heappop(heap)`
pythonOutlineComments:
